Migration preserves library categories, private membership, history/progress, bookmarks, notes/ratings, Reader settings and compatible tracker state. The selected destination is refreshed and validated before transfer. Existing downloads stay in place.
All compatible Miyorare data is always preserved during replacement. This safety is not optional.
